prompt: Name a film released from 1970 through 1979 that won Best Picture.

answers.name: The Godfather
answers.fact: 1972. Brando refused the Best Actor award the same night.

answers.name: Rocky
answers.fact: 1976. Shot in 28 days for around a million dollars.

answers.name: The Godfather Part II
answers.fact: 1974. The first sequel ever to win Best Picture.

answers.name: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
answers.fact: 1975. Only the second film to sweep all five top categories.

answers.name: Annie Hall
answers.fact: 1977. Beat Star Wars, which many expected to win.

answers.name: The Sting
answers.fact: 1973. Its ragtime score put Scott Joplin back on the charts decades after his death.

answers.name: The Deer Hunter
answers.fact: 1978. Shot largely in Ohio standing in for Pennsylvania steel country.

answers.name: Patton
answers.fact: 1970. George C. Scott declined his Best Actor Oscar and went to bed.

answers.name: The French Connection
answers.fact: 1971. The chase under the elevated train was filmed with no permits.
